cards.ex: When she heard she'd won the scholarship, she was beside herself with joy.
cards.exUz: U stipendiya yutganini eshitgach, xursandchiligidan o'zini yo'qotib qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli his-tuyg'ular, ayniqsa qayg'u yoki xursandchilik tufayli o'zini boshqara olmaslik.

cards.ex: She's putting a brave face on it, but I know she's really hurting inside.
cards.exUz: U jasur ko'rinishga harakat qilyapti, lekin men uning ich-ichidan azob chekayotganini bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda ham xafa bo'lmaslikka harakat qilish, jasur ko'rinishga urinish.

cards.ex: My dad went ballistic when he saw the dent in the car.
cards.exUz: Otam mashinadagi chuqurchani ko'rgach, jahl otiga mindi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga juda qattiq g'azablanish, o'zini tuta olmaslik.

cards.ex: I was a bundle of nerves before the presentation.
cards.exUz: Taqdimotdan oldin men juda asabiy edim.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiy, xavotirda yoki qo'rqqan holat.

cards.ex: They've been on cloud nine ever since they got engaged.
cards.exUz: Ular unashtirilganlaridan beri yettinchi osmonda uchib yurishibdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va baxtiyor holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: My mom will hit the roof if she finds out I skipped class.
cards.exUz: Agar onam dars qoldirganimni bilsa, juda jahli chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanish, qattiq jahli chiqish.

cards.ex: Hey, lighten up! It's just a game.
cards.exUz: Ey, yengil qara! Bu shunchaki o'yin.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy bo'lishni to'xtatish, xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: I get a kick out of watching old movies.
cards.exUz: Men eski filmlarni tomosha qilishdan rohatlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir zavqlanmoq, qoniqish his qilish.

cards.ex: His constant complaining is driving me up the wall.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari asabimga tegyapti.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yoki kimdir sizni juda asabiylashtirishi, toqatingizni toqat qilishi.

cards.ex: I had a sinking feeling when I saw the police car outside my house.
cards.exUz: Uyim tashqarisida politsiya mashinasini ko'rganimda, og'ir his paydo bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkinligini his qilish, umidsizlik.

cards.ex: He swept her off her feet with his charm and wit.
cards.exUz: U o'zining jozibasi va aqli bilan uni maftun qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir tez va to'liq sevib qolishiga sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: My parents burst with pride when I graduated.
cards.exUz: Men o'qishni tugatganimda ota-onam g'ururga to'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yutug'i tufayli juda faxrlanish.

cards.ex: Keep your chin up, things will get better.
cards.exUz: Ruhdan tushma, vaziyat yaxshilanadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda ham umidni yo'qotmaslik, bardoshli bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's been a nervous wreck ever since she lost her job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilganidan beri asabiy bemorga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiy va xavotirda bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: I'm in two minds about whether to go to the party or not.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofatga borish yoki bormaslik haqida ikki o'ydaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qaror qabul qila olmaslik, ikkilanish.

cards.ex: I know you're upset, but you just have to shake it off and move on.
cards.exUz: Bilaman xafasiz, lekin shunchaki e'tibor bermaslik va davom etish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yomon his-tuyg'ularni yoki xatolarni unuting, xotirjam bo'ling.

cards.ex: I don't like cleaning, but I just have to grin and bear it.
cards.exUz: Men tozalashni yoqtirmayman, lekin shunchaki tabassum bilan chidashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatga shikoyat qilmasdan sabr qilish.

cards.ex: Take heart, things will eventually get better.
cards.exUz: Umid qiling, vaziyat oxir-oqibat yaxshilanadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda ham umidni yo'qotmaslik, dalda topish.

cards.ex: He lost his cool and started yelling at the referee.
cards.exUz: U o'zini yo'qotib, hakamga baqira boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylashib o'zini boshqara olmaslik, jahl chiqish.

cards.ex: Losing the election was a bitter pill to swallow.
cards.exUz: Saylovda mag'lub bo'lish - hazm qilish qiyin bo'lgan achchiq dori edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish yoki hazm qilish qiyin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm really cheesed off with this weather.
cards.exUz: Bu ob-havo meni juda jonga tegdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan xafa bo'lish, jahli chiqishi.

cards.ex: I needed to get it off my chest, so I told her how I felt.
cards.exUz: Menga dardimni aytish kerak edi, shuning uchun unga o'z hislarimni aytdim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni bezovta qilayotgan narsani aytish, yengillashish.

cards.ex: I can't stand the smell of cigarettes.
cards.exUz: Men sigaret hidini yoqtirmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda yoqtirmaslik, toqat qilolmaslik.

cards.ex: I was gutted when I didn't get the job.
cards.exUz: Men ishga qabul qilinmaganimda umidsizlikka tushdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda xafa bo'lish, umidsizlikka tushish.

cards.ex: Whether he knew or not is beside the point; the damage is done.
cards.exUz: U bilganmi yoki yo'qmi, bu muhim emas; zarar allaqachon yetkazilgan.
cards.uzDef: Muhim emas, asosiy masalaga aloqasi yo'q.

cards.ex: Your compliment really made my day.
cards.exUz: Sizning maqtovingiz meni juda xursand qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir juda xursand qilish, kunini yaxshilash.

cards.ex: I've been feeling a little blue since she left.
cards.exUz: U ketganidan beri men biroz xafa bo'lyapman.
cards.uzDef: Xafa, tushkun kayfiyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zingizni tutishingiz va vahima qilishni to'xtatishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazoratga olish, xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: My parents will have a cow if they find out I crashed the car.
cards.exUz: Agar ota-onam mashinani urib olganimni bilib qolsa, juda jahl qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiylashish, g'azablanish.

cards.ex: He tried to make light of the situation, but it was actually very serious.
cards.exUz: U vaziyatni yengil qabul qilishga harakat qildi, lekin aslida juda jiddiy edi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy vaziyatni yengil qabul qilish, ahamiyat bermaslikka urinish.
